typing_rule: defect coordinates carry witnesses, coefficient domains, and authority roots; they are not booleans

defect_signature.I: contravariant presentation change does not preserve the distinction
defect_signature.C: covariant composition lacks a typed residual capability
defect_signature.M: the contravariant-covariant comparison square is absent, untyped, or anomalous
defect_signature.H: authorized comparison squares fail higher pasting coherence

forbidden_inferences: all pairwise C_2 cells implies H=0
a rational C_2 cell supplies an integral C_2 cell
